reason: E2 directly shows that Hf addition to a similar W-Ta-Cr-V alloy suppresses precipitation and enhances homogeneity under irradiation at 1073 K, supporting the core premise. However, the cited evidence does not directly address the effect on irradiation hardening or the specific mechanism of severe lattice distortion impeding diffusion, and E3 is unrelated to the Hf-modified system.
premises: Hf addition suppresses Cr-V precipitation in W-Ta-Cr-V alloys under irradiation
Hf addition enhances homogeneity and reduces compositional striations
Severe lattice distortion from Hf impedes Cr/V diffusion
Hf addition does not increase irradiation hardening
